title: Meeting Leonard Chess and trips to Chicago
summary: He says Leonard Chess was involved with his sessions, and he went to Chicago but did not record there.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
